annotations.text:
Clickable. Library / Dictionary / New article all navigate, and article rows open the reader.

In the reader: drag the 難易度 slider to change how many words are marked — that is the frequency threshold. Hover a dashed word for its senses.

Click the blue phrase (standing in for a text selection) to open Q&A. It opens on a greeting, not an answer; pick a suggestion to carry the conversation on. Hover cards stop firing while it is open.

Changed from the first version:

· Q&A moved from a per-sentence ? button to text selection
· The rail is gone — the card sits by the selection
· Q&A is a chat, opening on a templated greeting
· Word cards show all senses, not one line
· Difficulty slider added, and it works
· Grammar reads zero everywhere
· JMdict attribution on the Dictionary page

Still open:

· Which Ollama model beyond qwen3.8:27b
· Whether the reader must work when the model host is unreachable
· JMnedict, once we can count how many unmatched words are names
· UI chrome language: nav is English, controls are Japanese, explanations are Chinese

The mobile board draws the OS Copy/Look-Up menu deliberately — it will sit over our card and cannot be suppressed without reimplementing selection.
